capabilities: Jump the cursor out of the current Markdown environment with Tab
Add custom tab-out rules for any environment via a command
Specify which characters to jump to when defining a rule
extras: The README's install steps reference disabling Safe Mode, which is outdated for current Obsidian versions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to escape out of inline markup characters with the keyboard, forcing manual arrow-key movement.
summary: Keyboard helper that moves the cursor past the closing character of Markdown formatting such as links or bold when you press Tab.
